definitions.rms: centered population standard deviation; no independent-seed uncertainty
definitions.vx_vy: native dimensionless transverse direction components, approximately radians at small angle
definitions.polarization: mean spin projection onto own native direction, beam1 +z and beam2 -z; spin magnitude retained
definitions.time: luminosity and emissions accumulated over inclusive diagonal interval; bunch moments use stored endpoint states, not drift-synchronized display copies
definitions.coordinates: native simulated frame; no design crossing-angle or detector-plane transformation

nominal_polarization.convention: effective configured native spin vectors for generated beams; loaded spins may differ; reference helicity uses design +/-z

primary_species.basis: canonical e+e- primary beam assignment; not per-particle species measurement

unavailable_reasons.beam_moments: Requires complete native collision pair moment coverage and nonzero luminosity; optimized precompute modes are not instrumented
unavailable_reasons.polarization: Requires stored spin and positive collision luminosity weight
unavailable_reasons.chi_e: Requires instrumented serial primary mover; no stale snapshot upsilon substitutes
unavailable_reasons.chi_e_electron: Requires instrumented serial primary mover and exact charge_sign=-1 canonical e+e- assignment; other charge modes have no species inference
unavailable_reasons.chi_e_positron: Requires instrumented serial primary mover and exact charge_sign=-1 canonical e+e- assignment; other charge modes have no species inference
unavailable_reasons.chi_gamma: Computed only by native coherent photon path; ordinary photon propagation does not evaluate chi_gamma
unavailable_reasons.photon_energy: Requires radiation enabled and instrumented serial physics; native emission records are not physical yield weights
unavailable_reasons.pair_energy: Requires incoherent-pair generation and instrumented serial physics; excludes other pair mechanisms

nominal_reference.native_W: Existing massive invariant mass of native simulated incoming directions; no design crossing rotation; beam energies before optional ISR sampling
